svg.title: TYPE_CHARGE_AGV -> PlanAgvChargeJob()
svg.desc: Send AGV-1 to the cheapest free charger. AGV-1 is trapped in bay B21 (insert mode), so the bay is switched to retrieve mode to let it out and switched back afterwards.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. The AGV must exist and be enabled. In this example: AGV-1 is enabled. (passes)", "Row 3. An AGV already on a charger, facing the charger's inbound heading, needs nothing. In this example: AGV-1 is in a bay. (no early exit)", "Row 4. An AGV in a bay that is in insert mode is trapped: switch the bay to retrieve mode first. Any bay state other than these two fails the job. In this example: B21 is READY_TO_INSERT, so AGV-1 is trapped until the bay switches. (adds 1)", "Row 5. Cost every charger with no AGV on it by travel time, using a path search that avoids current obstacles; keep the cheapest. In this example: C16 is skipped (AGV-2). C14 and C10 are costed; C14 is cheaper. 'Free' only means no AGV on the node, not that its surroundings are clear. (best = C14)", "Row 6. No reachable free charger: fail with a warning about the battery. In this example: C14 was found. (skipped)", "Row 7. Drive the AGV to the chosen charger (reuses PlanAgvMoveJob). In this example: Replays event 1 (bay now READY_TO_RETRIEVE), adds the move, rule A (AGV-1) and rule B (after 1). (adds 2 \u00b7 B)", "Row 8. If the AGV was trapped, put the bay back into insert mode (reuses PlanBayTransitionJob). In this example: Puts B21 back into insert mode: rule A after 1 and rule B after 2. (adds 3 \u00b7 A, B)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): event 1. B21 switches to READY_TO_RETRIEVE.", "Playing the plan: event 2. AGV-1 drives B21 -> W41 -> W22 -> W18 -> W13 -> P15 -> C14.", "Playing the plan: event 3. B21 switches to READY_TO_INSERT. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
